sections.heading_es: ## Para qué sirve mejor el correo electrónico
sections.rationale: Purpose and appropriate uses need no additional interface image.

sections.heading_es: ## Antes de enviar desde el Inbox
sections.rationale: Prerequisites and links cover sender setup; a fictional active sender cannot prove DNS/provider verification.

sections.heading_es: ## Dónde puedes usar correo electrónico
sections.rationale: Show current Email destination and two fictional recipient addresses; keep availability and actual sending prerequisites distinct.

sections.heading_es: ## Entiende el remitente, el destinatario y la dirección de respuesta
sections.heading_en: ## Understand the sender, recipient, and reply address
sections.rationale: Recipient selection screenshot supports the identity table. Sender/reply-address routing is explained from source without invented received mail.

sections.heading_es: ## Envía un correo desde el Inbox
sections.heading_en: ## Send an email from the Inbox
sections.rationale: Capture actual recipient selection, Subject/body editor and Preview controls; send step remains a prospective reader instruction.

sections.heading_es: ## Qué recibe el cliente
sections.rationale: Capture the actual unsent design preview with native desktop/mobile controls; no delivered email claim.

sections.heading_es: ### Links y personalización
sections.rationale: Useful reserved example URL in the prepared body illustrates an action. Tracking/personalization links retain their own canonical guides.

sections.heading_es: ## Longitud del texto y archivos adjuntos
sections.rationale: Correct limits use native code contracts. No fake validation-error screenshot or upload is required to explain the table.

sections.heading_es: ## Cómo llegan las respuestas del cliente al Inbox
sections.heading_en: ## How customer replies reach the Inbox
sections.rationale: Reply routing explanation is preserved. No provider/inbound email event is manufactured for a screenshot.

sections.heading_es: ### Respuestas desde otra dirección
sections.rationale: Another-address behavior is explained without staging a misleading customer reply.

sections.heading_es: ### Correos nuevos enviados a la casilla existente de tu negocio
sections.heading_en: ### New emails sent to your existing business mailbox
sections.rationale: Existing mailbox distinction and support link need no fabricated mailbox interface.

sections.heading_es: ## Responsables de la conversación y ventanas de respuesta
sections.rationale: Ownership/window procedures belong to the linked native guides; this batch does not change ownership or simulate a provider reply.

sections.heading_es: ## Estado de suscripción y solicitudes de baja
sections.rationale: Keep scope of contact/channel subscriptions explicit; no local consent toggle is needed for this screenshot batch.

sections.heading_es: ## Entiende la información de envío, entrega y lectura
sections.heading_en: ## Understand sending, delivery, and read information
sections.rationale: Describe delivery/open signals and their limits; an unsent preview cannot supply genuine provider delivery or read receipts.

sections.heading_es: ## Soluciona problemas de una conversación por correo
sections.rationale: Troubleshooting groups consolidate the concrete cases below.

sections.heading_es: ### Correo electrónico no aparece en el menú de destino
sections.heading_en: ### Email is missing from the destination menu
sections.rationale: Native recipient selector plus prerequisite text supports this case; no guessed error state.

sections.heading_es: ### El mensaje usó un remitente o un asunto inesperados
sections.heading_en: ### The message used an unexpected sender or subject
sections.rationale: Subject editor image resolves the obsolete fixed-business-name claim; sender configuration stays with its linked guide.

sections.heading_es: ### El cliente no encuentra un correo enviado
sections.heading_en: ### The customer cannot find a sent email
sections.rationale: Delivery checks remain prospective and do not require a manufactured delivered/failure status.

sections.heading_es: ### La respuesta del cliente no aparece
sections.heading_en: ### The customer's reply does not appear
sections.rationale: Reply checks do not require a forged incoming event.

sections.heading_es: ### Un adjunto falla o se ve diferente
sections.heading_en: ### An attachment fails or looks different
sections.rationale: Current native image types/size and inline behavior are specified; optional image controls only if visible without upload.

sections.heading_es: ## Checklist para la primera conversación por correo
sections.rationale: Retain useful end-to-end reader test checklist; local editorial capture executes no send or provider verification.
